title: ATM with a custom exception
prompt: Implement nested class `Solution.InsufficientFundsException : Exception` with a `public decimal Missing { get; }` (constructor `(decimal missing)` passing a message to base and storing it), plus `static decimal Withdraw(decimal balance, decimal amount)` throwing `ArgumentException` for non-positive amounts and `InsufficientFundsException` when `amount > balance` (Missing = amount − balance); success returns the new balance.

tests.name: normal
tests.code:
Cj.Eq(Solution.Withdraw(100m, 40m), 60m, "normal withdrawal");
Cj.Eq(Solution.Withdraw(100m, 100m), 0m, "exact balance is legal");
tests.hint: Withdrawing exactly the balance leaves 0 — legal.

tests.name: custom
tests.hint: The custom type carries structured data (Missing) a generic exception couldn't.
